vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species schizosaccharomyces_pombe --assembly ASM294v2 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (MT, III and AB325691) at their full length from Schizosaccharomyces_pombe.ASM294v2.dna.chromosome.MT.fa.gz, Schizosaccharomyces_pombe.ASM294v2.dna.chromosome.III.fa.gz and Schizosaccharomyces_pombe.ASM294v2.dna.nonchromosomal.fa.gz of Ensembl Genomes release 63 (Ensembl Fungi), each file held to the sum of the directory's CHECKSUMS; every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 295 records on the mitochondrion (MT, 70 records), chromosome III (204) and the unplaced sequence AB325691 (21); eleven of them name their sequence by a synonym the cache's chr_synonyms.txt lists. 226 come from tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 2, seed 1, --records wide, one --sequence for each of the three sequences, every reference allele read from the genome file), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal: 29 categories, among them a substitution in the codon genetic code 4 reads differently from the standard code, start and stop codons under codes 1 and 4, a missense and a synonymous change on each strand, both splice sites, both untranslated regions, an intron, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion, an in-frame deletion, the first and the last base of each sequence and a deletion across the origin of the mitochondrion. 69 are known variants of the cache's own variation files: single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from all_vars.gz of the three sequences, each under the cache's identifier, in position order; five records are multi-allelic

hgvs.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species schizosaccharomyces_pombe --assembly ASM294v2 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --hgvs [--tab|--vcf|--json]

generator: Ensembl VEP over the two record pools under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly ASM294v2 --species schizosaccharomyces_pombe --dataset wide=<reference>=<the generated records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the sampled known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <the named records> --covers species-fission-yeast-asm294v2 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl Fungi release 63 ASM294v2 cache (the cache carries no SIFT or PolyPhen predictions and no regulatory data); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <the three sequences> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, run over the records with each sequence synonym written as the cache's name; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp for the hgvs set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: all_vars.gz with its index under variations/<sequence>/ for the three sequences, cut from the cache's variation files to the records within one base of a record of the corpus: 90 on III and 15 on MT; AB325691 has none there and carries the empty indexed file

genetic_code_check.table: Bio/Tools/CodonTable.pm of the reference image (/opt/vep/src/ensembl-vep/Bio/Tools/CodonTable.pm): the residues of table 1 on line 229 and of table 4 on line 232, which differ at one codon, the fifteenth in the table's own order; the start codons of table 4 on line 261
genetic_code_check.records: variants.vcf line 35 (code4_changed_codon_1) and line 51 (code4_changed_codon_2), both on that codon and both kept by name
genetic_code_check.checked: every row of expected/default.txt.gz on MT that prints two whole codons, 44 rows: the Amino_acids column equals the translation of both codons under table 4 as that file gives it; five of the rows sit on the codon the two tables read differently, the rows of the two named records among them
